title: Union find operations
statementMd:
Maintain `n` elements (0..n-1) in disjoint sets. `['union', a, b]` merges the sets, `['connected', a, b]` returns a bool, `['count']` returns the number of sets. Return the results of connected and count in order.

**Example:** `union_find_ops(4, [["union", 0, 1], ["connected", 0, 1], ["connected", 0, 2],…)` returns `[true, false, 3]`.
hints: Path compression plus union by size.
